es: Escribir un cambio personal combinando hecho fechado, actividad en curso, resultado, causa y estado actual.

teaching.en: I started running in March, so my routine has changed.
teaching.es: Empecé a correr en marzo, así que mi rutina ha cambiado.
teaching.explanationEs: El hecho con fecha va en past simple (started); su efecto, en present perfect.
teaching.audioText: I started running in March, so my routine has changed.

teaching.en: I've been sleeping earlier for two months, and it is a good habit now.
teaching.es: Llevo dos meses durmiendo más temprano y ahora es un buen hábito.
teaching.explanationEs: Actividad que dura (been sleeping) + efecto actual en presente (is a good habit).
segments: I've been sleeping earlier for two months,
and it is a good habit now.
teaching.audioText: I've been sleeping earlier for two months, and it is a good habit now.

teaching.en: I've passed two exams since I moved here.
teaching.es: He aprobado dos exámenes desde que me mudé aquí.
teaching.explanationEs: Two exams es una cantidad: el resultado pide present perfect simple.
teaching.audioText: I've passed two exams since I moved here.

teaching.en: Last year I felt stressed because I worked too much.
teaching.es: El año pasado me sentía estresado porque trabajaba demasiado.
teaching.explanationEs: La causa en el pasado con fecha (last year) va en past simple.
teaching.audioText: Last year I felt stressed because I worked too much.

teaching.en: Now I'm more confident, and my English has improved.
teaching.es: Ahora estoy más seguro y mi inglés ha mejorado.
teaching.explanationEs: El estado actual va en presente; el progreso, en present perfect.
teaching.audioText: Now I'm more confident, and my English has improved.

prompt.es: Según las notas, ¿qué frase cuenta el hecho con fecha?

choices.text: I've started a course in September.
I started a course in September.
I'm starting a course since September.

feedback.es: September es un mes concreto ya pasado: past simple, I started. Con una fecha no se usa have.

hint.es: Un mes concreto pide el tiempo del pasado terminado.

origin.text: Notes: change = new course. When? September. Now: still studying.

prompt.es: Completa: «Desde entonces he estado estudiando cada noche.»

feedback.es: Since then une el pasado con hoy y la actividad dura: been + verbo con -ing.

hint.es: Es una actividad que sigue: después de been va un verbo con -ing.

origin.text: Since then, I've been ___ every night.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase expresa bien «He aprobado dos exámenes»?

choices.text: I've been passing two exams.
I pass two exams since March.
I've passed two exams.

feedback.es: Two exams es una cantidad: el resultado se cuenta con present perfect simple, I've passed.

hint.es: Contar un resultado pide have + participio.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Me sentía estresado porque trabajaba demasiado.»

answer.text: I felt stressed because I worked too much

feedback.es: La causa en el pasado va en past simple: felt y worked, unidas por because.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué ha conseguido el hablante con el cambio.

choices.text: The speaker has kept more money.
The speaker has spent more money.
The speaker has lost a job.

feedback.es: Saved a lot of money significa que ahorra: cocinar en casa le hace conservar más dinero.

origin.audio: I've been cooking at home since January, so I've saved a lot of money.

prompt.es: ¿Qué frase cierra bien el párrafo con el estado actual?

choices.text: Now I felt more confident.
Now I feel more confident.
Now I have been feel more confident.

feedback.es: El estado de hoy va en presente: Now I feel. Felt es pasado y have been feel mezcla formas.

origin.text: I changed my routine in January. I've been walking to work since then.

prompt.es: Según las notas, ¿qué frase resume el resultado del cambio?

choices.text: I've been making three new friends.
I made three new friends since then.
I've made three new friends.

feedback.es: Three new friends es una cantidad: resultado con present perfect simple. Las otras formas no cuentan resultados.

origin.text: Notes: moved to Quito in 2019. Since then: working at a school. Result: three new friends.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué se apuntó el hablante al equipo.

choices.text: To feel less alone.
To lose weight.
To make money.

feedback.es: Felt lonely explica la causa: se apuntó para sentirse menos solo.

origin.audio: I felt lonely, so I joined a football team. I've been playing every Tuesday since then.

prompt.es: Escribe cómo has cambiado con los datos dados (25–70 palabras).

answer.text: Last year I felt nervous about my English because I wanted a better job. I started studying in January, and I've been studying every night since then. I've learned three hundred words, so now I feel more confident.
accepted: Last year I felt nervous about my English because I wanted a better job. I started studying in January, and I've been studying every night since then. I've learned three hundred words, so now I feel more confident.

Last year I felt insecure about my English because I wanted a better job. I began learning in January, and I have been learning every night since then. I have learned 300 words, so I feel more confident now.

I wanted a better job, so I started studying English in January. Since then, I've been studying every night, and I've learned three hundred words. Last year I felt nervous, but now I feel more confident.

feedback.es: Un buen párrafo combina past simple (felt, started), have been + -ing (actividad), have + participio (resultado) y presente (feel).

origin.text: Datos: el año pasado te sentías inseguro con tu inglés porque querías un trabajo mejor (causa); empezaste a estudiar en enero (hecho con fecha); desde entonces estudias cada noche (actividad que sigue); has aprendido 300 palabras (resultado); ahora te sientes más seguro (estado actual).

prompt.es: Completa: «Me siento más seguro desde entonces.»

feedback.es: Feel es un verbo de estado: present perfect simple, I've felt (o I've been), y since then une el pasado con hoy; nunca I've been feeling con este sentido.

prompt.es: ¿Qué versión corrige el borrador sobre Bristol?

choices.text: I've moved to Bristol in June. I worked at a gym since then.
I moved to Bristol in June. I've been working at a gym since then.
I moved to Bristol in June. I work at a gym since then.

feedback.es: In June pide past simple: la primera frase era la que fallaba. La segunda ya estaba bien; las otras versiones la estropean (worked / work con since then).

origin.text: Draft: 'I've moved to Bristol in June. I've been working at a gym since then.'

prompt.es: Escucha y elige qué resultado menciona el hablante.

choices.text: He has started twelve stories.
He has read twelve stories.
He has completed twelve stories.

feedback.es: Finished twelve stories es un resultado contado: doce historias terminadas.

origin.audio: Since June, I've been writing every weekend, and I've finished twelve stories.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Duermo mejor desde que cambié mi rutina.»

answer.text: I've been sleeping better since I changed my routine

feedback.es: Since + past simple (changed) da el inicio; I've been sleeping better describe lo que dura desde entonces.
